problems.title: 1. LRU Cache with TTL & Generics
problems.problemStatement: Design and implement a thread-safe, fixed-capacity Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache supporting get(key) and put(key, value, [ttl]) in strict O(1) time complexity. When the cache hits capacity, the least recently accessed item must be evicted.
extensions: Generic templated types for Key and Value
dataStructuresUsed: std::unordered_map (Hash Table mapping Key -> Node pointer for O(1) lookups)
Custom Doubly Linked List (Head = Most Recently Used, Tail = Least Recently Used for O(1) removals and insertions)
designPatterns: Composition Pattern (combining Hash Map with Doubly Linked List)
edgeCasesHandled: Key lookup when key has expired via TTL (lazy eviction on get)
Updating value of an already existing key without increasing cache size
Evicting strictly from tail while cleaning up map references
Capacity initialized to 1 or small constraints
Concurrent multi-threaded access without race conditions

problems.title: 2. Multi-Floor Parking Lot System
problems.problemStatement: Design a multi-floor parking lot system supporting diverse vehicle types (Motorbike, Car, Truck, EV Car) with automated spot matching, entry ticket issuance, dynamic parking fee calculation on exit, and pluggable slot allocation strategies.
extensions: Dynamic fee calculation based on vehicle type and duration
Support for multiple entry and exit gates
dataStructuresUsed: std::vector for hierarchical floors and spot collections
std::unordered_map for active ticket tracking and O(1) ticket checkout lookups
designPatterns: Strategy Pattern: Spot Allocation (NearestFirstParkingStrategy) and Pricing (HourlyFeeStrategy)
Factory / Polymorphism: Vehicle and ParkingSpot class hierarchies
Single Responsibility Principle: Clear separation between spot, floor, ticket, and lot controller

timeComplexity.parkVehicle: O(F * S) where F is floors and S is spots per floor
timeComplexity.unparkVehicle: O(1) ticket lookup and spot release

edgeCasesHandled: No spots available for a specific vehicle category
Invalid or expired ticket ID verification on checkout
Truck or large vehicle attempting to park in small/compact spots
Zero-minute or instant exit charged with minimum 1-hour base rate

problems.title: 3. N x N Tic-Tac-Toe with O(1) Win Check & Undo
problems.problemStatement: Build an extensible N x N Tic-Tac-Toe game supporting 2 or more players. Every move must be strictly validated, and win/draw condition must be evaluated in O(1) time without looping through the entire grid. Supports an Undo move capability.
extensions: Arbitrary N x N board size
Undo functionality using move command history stack
Pluggable player strategies (Human vs Bot/AI player)
dataStructuresUsed: std::vector<int> for rowCounts and colCounts to evaluate win status in O(1)
int diagCount and antiDiagCount tracking diagonal sums
designPatterns: Strategy Pattern (Player interface with HumanPlayer vs BotPlayer)
Command / Memento Pattern (storing Move history on stack for undo operations)
problems.spaceComplexity: O(N^2) for grid and O(Total Moves) for undo stack
edgeCasesHandled: Placing a piece on an already occupied cell
Out of bounds coordinates validation
Board full detection (Draw condition) when total moves equal N*N
Invoking Undo on an empty board

problems.title: 4. Library Management System
problems.problemStatement: Design a system where members can search, checkout, return, and reserve books. A book can have multiple physical copies (BookItems). Overdue returns trigger automated fine calculations, and returning a reserved copy immediately notifies the waiting member.
extensions: Search catalog by Title, Author, or ISBN
Observer pattern notifying members on reservation availability
Configurable checkout limits and daily overdue fine calculations
dataStructuresUsed: std::unordered_map for indexing books by ISBN, Author, and Title
std::queue<std::shared_ptr<Member>> for FIFO reservation waitlist per book copy
designPatterns: Observer Pattern: Notifying waiting members when a book item is checked in
Domain Separation: Book (Metadata) vs BookItem (Physical Copy with Barcode and State)
problems.spaceComplexity: O(Total Books + Total Members + Active Loans)
edgeCasesHandled: Member reaching maximum allowed active checkouts (e.g., max 5 books)
Calculating daily compounding fines on delayed returns past due date
Transitioning book status to RESERVED when a waitlist exists rather than AVAILABLE
Handling concurrent reservation queue order

problems.title: 5. Vending Machine (State Pattern)
problems.problemStatement: Implement a vending machine capable of holding inventory, accepting coins/cash, dispensing requested products, returning remaining change, and handling cancellations with a full refund. The machine must enforce valid state transitions without nested conditionals.
dataStructuresUsed: std::unordered_map<std::string, Item> for product inventory by aisle code
designPatterns: State Pattern: Encapsulating state-dependent behavior in dedicated State classes
edgeCasesHandled: Selecting an item with insufficient deposited balance
Selecting an item that is out of stock (quantity = 0)
Attempting to dispense when no money was inserted
Cancelling transaction while dispensing (strictly prohibited by state machine)
Accurate change calculation and balance reset
